name: Summarize Meeting Notes
description: Analyze raw meeting transcripts, discussion logs, or scratchpad notes to generate a polished executive summary, a concise list of key decisions made, and an actionable checklist of follow-up tasks with assignees and target deadlines.

inputs.meeting_notes: Raw transcript or rough meeting notes
inputs.participants: List of attendees and key stakeholders present

outputs.executive_summary: High-level summary of meeting agenda, key takeaways, and strategic alignment
outputs.key_decisions: Numbered list of explicit decisions agreed upon by the team
outputs.action_items: Bulleted checklist of tasks with designated owners and deadlines

sample_inputs.meeting_notes:
Quarterly Sprint Sync (Sept 2026):
Alice: Our API latency spiked to 450ms during peak load on the auth service.
Bob: I traced it to unindexed PostgreSQL queries on session_tokens. I can add a composite B-tree index by Wednesday.
Carol: We need to roll out the new ChromaDB vector search endpoint by Friday for the mobile team. Client SDK is ready.
Alice: Agreed. Bob handles the DB index patch, Carol merges the vector service. I will notify the mobile team once staging passes verification on Thursday.
sample_inputs.participants: Alice (Engineering Lead), Bob (Backend Infra), Carol (AI/Vector Systems)
